clips.title: The story
paras: Naralex is a night elf druid who sought to restore the parched Barrens to a lush forest using the powers of the Emerald Dream. Instead, his slumber was overtaken by a dark nightmare, twisting the Wailing Caverns beneath the earth and turning his followers into venomous fiends.

Long before the Great Sundering, the sun-scorched plains of the Barrens were once a vibrant forest. Viewing this loss as a tragedy, Naralex journeyed to the Barrens with a cohort of devoted disciples to reverse the drought. Deep beneath the savannah, he discovered an intricate subterranean network of underground springs and rushing geysers, naming them the Wailing Caverns after the howling wind and steam that moaned through the rock. He believed that by entering a deep trance and channeling the pristine energies of the Emerald Dream into these subterranean waters, the life-giving flow would reach the surface and cause the entire wasteland to bloom.

Naralex seated himself in deep meditation deep within the subterranean caverns, but his noble design collapsed the moment his consciousness touched the realm of the Dream. Rather than finding peaceful fonts of wild nature, his mind was ensnared by a malignant, encroaching corruption—an Emerald Nightmare. The festering corruption seized the sleeping druid's body, transforming him into an open conduit through which dark energies bled into the living world. The pristine springs turned foul, sprouting mutated fungal blooms and warping the native beasts of the caverns into ravenous deviate horrors.
